front: LLM & AI model APIs, inference and agent platforms
front_title: LLM & AI APIs — Free Tiers, Trial Credits & Startup/Student Offers

entries.name: Google Gemini API (AI Studio) Free Tier
entries.offer: Free input + output tokens on eligible models (Gemini 3.8/3.6 Flash, 3.5 & 3.1 Flash-Lite, Gemini Embedding 2, Gemma 4) with per-project RPM/TPM/RPD limits; no billing account or card required
entries.notes: Verified Oct 2026. Free tier covers Flash/Flash-Lite/embedding models; Gemini 3.1 Pro and image/video are paid-only. Paid tier now requires a $5 min prepay. Free-tier content may be used to improve Google products. Exact per-model limits shown in AI Studio, not published.

entries.name: Google Cloud for Startups (AI startup program)
entries.offer: Up to $200,000 GCP credits over 2 years (Scale tier); up to $350,000 for AI-first startups; $2,000 self-serve Start tier
entries.notes: No equity taken. Start = pre-funded MVP; Scale = pre-seed to Series A VC-backed. Credits cover Gemini/Gemma; third-party models billed directly. AI-first ceiling raised to $350K (Y1 100% up to $250K + Y2 20% up to $100K) as of late 2026.

entries.name: GroqCloud Free Plan
entries.offer: No-card free plan: gpt-oss-120b & qwen-3.8-27b at 30 RPM / 1,000 RPD / 8K TPM / 200K TPD; smaller models like llama-3.1-8b reach ~14,400 RPD
entries.notes: Limits are per organization. Free model list rotates (dropped/added models in 2026). Developer-tier upgrades were paused in 2026 due to demand. Confirm the current model list in the console.

entries.name: Cohere Trial API key
entries.offer: Auto-issued trial key: 1,000 free API calls/month across all endpoints (Chat 20 req/min; Embed 2,000 inputs/min), no card, non-commercial
entries.notes: Trial keys are for prototyping/research, not production or commercial use. Some models (e.g. North Mini Code) are free on production keys too. Not offered in ~10 countries. Production keys are pay-as-you-go.

entries.name: Mistral AI Studio (La Plateforme) Free Mode
entries.offer: Free API mode on by default, no card; included monthly usage with rate caps shown only in the console Limits page
entries.notes: Mistral stopped publishing a fixed free amount; the '$10/mo API credit' line was removed from the pricing page on Oct 7 2026, so check your Limits page. Free requests may be used to train models unless you opt out in Admin > Privacy. Verified students get Mistral Pro at $5.99/mo.

entries.name: Cerebras Inference Free Trial
entries.offer: $5 one-time trial credit granted after adding a payment method, expires in 30 days; Free Trial limits ~5 RPM and 1M tokens/day on gpt-oss-120b & qwen-3.8-27b
entries.notes: Card required (adding is free). The old always-free '1M tokens/day, no card' tier ended 21 July 2026. After the trial, usage is pay-as-you-go on the Developer tier.

entries.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
entries.offer: Former free-account monthly inference credit is now discontinued — free accounts get none; PRO ($9/mo) includes $2/mo of compute credits
entries.notes: CHANGED 7 Oct 2026: free users lost the $0.10/mo credit and must buy credits (or route through a custom provider key, where that provider's own free tier applies). Free accounts still get ZeroGPU Spaces (~5 GPU-min/day) and free CPU Spaces. Use the changed-status note for the mega-index.

entries.name: Replicate 'Try for Free' collection
entries.offer: A limited number of free runs on selected models (e.g. FLUX, Imagen-4, Whisper, video upscaling) with no card; no published dollar amount
entries.notes: Widely-claimed '$5' or '$500' signup credits are not on any official Replicate page — official wording is 'free for a limited number of runs'. Acquired by Cloudflare Dec 2025. No startup program (replicate.com/startups returns 404); purchased credit is prepaid, valid 1 year.

entries.name: OpenRouter Free Models
entries.offer: ':free' model variants (openrouter/free router too): 20 RPM and 50 requests/day, rising to 1,000/day after a one-time $10 credit purchase; ~18 free models
entries.notes: No card needed to use free models. OpenRouter marks some free-model providers (NVIDIA, Thinking Machines) as ones that may train on your data — treat free models as public. The free-model list rotates and some entries have end dates.

entries.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
entries.offer: 10,000 free Neurons/day on the Workers Free plan (resets 00:00 UTC) across ~80 models; above that, $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons on Workers Paid
entries.notes: No card needed for the free daily pool. Some frontier models require a paid billing method even within the pool. On the Paid plan, overage bills instead of failing — set usage monitoring. The pool is per account, shared across all Workers.

entries.name: NVIDIA NIM / build.nvidia.com
entries.offer: Free rate-limited hosted inference (~40 RPM, up to ~10,000 requests/day) via the free NVIDIA Developer Program; plus a free 90-day NVIDIA AI Enterprise trial
entries.notes: Hosted endpoints are free for prototyping/development only; production requires a paid NVIDIA AI Enterprise license. Downloadable NIM microservices are free for dev/test on up to 16 GPUs. Per-model limits vary and aren't a single published quota.

entries.name: Microsoft for Startups
entries.offer: Up to $150,000 Azure credits over time (investor-referred); without a referral, ~$200 starter + $4,000 credits; covers Microsoft Foundry / Azure OpenAI
entries.notes: Pre-seed to Series B B2B startups; Investor Network referral unlocks higher tiers. Program restructured 29 May 2026. Credits valid up to 2 years after activation; a card is required (not charged until credits run out).

entries.name: AWS Activate (Amazon Bedrock)
entries.offer: Up to ~$100K in AWS credits (Portfolio/Partner tier; ~$100 Founders self-serve), usable on Amazon Bedrock including third-party models (Claude, Llama, Mistral)
entries.notes: Amazon Bedrock itself has NO free token tier — it bills per token from the first call and runs down your AWS credits. New AWS accounts get up to $200 promotional credits (6 months). Larger Activate amounts need an investor/provider referral.

entries.name: GitHub Copilot (Free & Student plans)
entries.offer: Copilot Free: 2,000 code completions/month + a monthly AI-credit allowance, no subscription; Copilot Student: free for verified students with unlimited completions
entries.notes: Free plan is personal-use, auto model selection, no card. Student plan needs school verification. Copilot Pro is free for verified teachers and popular-OSS maintainers. AI credits = $0.01 each, reset monthly.

entries.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
entries.offer: Free bundle for verified students with dozens of partner offers: developer tools, cloud and API credits, and learning resources (GitHub, Microsoft Azure, Datadog, Deepnote, and more)
entries.notes: Verify with a school email. Individual partner offers and amounts change frequently — treat this as a directory and confirm each partner's current offer. Includes a GitHub free-month plus partner perks.

entries.name: Azure for Students
entries.offer: Verified students: $100 in Azure credits, 12 months of Visual Studio Pro, plus other dev-kit benefits (at no cost)
entries.notes: Long-standing free dev kit for verified students, distinct from the paid Microsoft for Startups program. Requires school verification (email, ID, or acceptance letter).

entries.name: xAI Grok API
entries.offer: No standing free API tier; the old $25/month beta credit ended Dec 2024 and $150/month data-sharing claims are not on current billing docs — pay-as-you-go from first call
entries.notes: OpenAI-compatible at api.x.ai/v1; Grok 4.7 $2 in / $6 out per 1M. xAI now operates under 'SpaceXSI' branding (domains unchanged). Verify any promo code or account-specific credit in your console before relying on it.

entries.name: OpenAI (ChatGPT / API)
entries.offer: No free API credits for developers — the API is pay-as-you-go from the first token; a consumer ChatGPT Free plan (rate-limited) exists
entries.notes: OpenAI GPT frontier models are not on any free tier. Free access to OpenAI models is possible indirectly via Hugging Face / Bedrock (which carry their own free credits) and GitHub Copilot free plan. Check console for any current promo.

entries.name: Anthropic Claude API
entries.offer: No free API tier or developer credit program; a consumer Claude (claude.ai) Free plan exists; Claude is reachable on Bedrock/Vertex via their credits
entries.notes: API is pay-as-you-go (Claude Haiku is the cheapest). Claude models appear free-ish through other platforms' free tiers/credits (e.g. Bedrock $200 credits), not from Anthropic itself.

entries.name: Baseten (via Google Cloud Startup Perks)
entries.offer: Up to $25,000 in credits for dedicated deployments/training and up to $2,500 for model APIs, as a Google for Startups ecosystem perk
entries.notes: Accessed through the Google for Startups Perks program, not Baseten self-serve. Baseten models are also available via Hugging Face Inference Providers and Amazon Bedrock.

front: GPU, ML training & notebooks — free tiers, trial credits, student offers and startup programs, verified against official pages (checked 2026-10-22). Verified live: Kaggle 30h/wk GPU quota, Colab free T4 (dynamic limits, 12h sessions), HF Spaces free ZeroGPU (5 min/day; as of July 2026 all new compute Spaces incl. CPU Basic are paywalled, free accounts keep only 2 ZeroGPU Spaces + free Static), Paperspace free M4000 notebooks, Modal $30/mo Starter, GCP $300/90d trial + e2-micro, Azure $200/30d + B1s 750h/mo x12mo, AWS new $200/6mo free plan (old p3 12h/mo free tier ended July 2025). NOT free (checked 2026-09/10, official pages show nothing free): TensorDock (no free credit), Vast.ai (no free credit), DataCrunch — now rebranded Verda (pure pay-as-you-go, no free tier/credit), Spheron (paid per-minute marketplace, H100 ~$2.98/hr; only sporadic community token giveaways), RunPod for ordinary users (no free tier; only a $1,000 startup-tier credit and enterprise/academic programs). Also closed: AWS SageMaker Studio Lab (free Jupyter+GPU) and Colab Pro for Education, both closed to new signups 2026-07-30. Lambda has no signup credit — only its competitive up-to-$5,000 Research Grant for academic researchers. Local open-source runtimes (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio, GPUStack, SGLang) remain free-for-all on your own GPU.
front_title: GPU, ML Training & Notebooks — Free Compute (2026-10-22)

entries.name: Kaggle Notebooks (Free GPU/TPU)
entries.offer: Free weekly quota ~30 GPU hours/week (P100 or 2xT4) + 20 TPU v3-8 hours/week, sessions max 12h GPU / 9h TPU, no credit card
entries.notes: Quota published by Kaggle docs ('30 hours or sometimes higher depending on demand'). GPU/internet access requires one-time phone verification. P100 reportedly being retired in 2026, accelerator menu changes over time.

entries.name: Google Colab Free Tier
entries.offer: Free browser Jupyter notebooks with T4 GPU (16GB) and TPU access; sessions up to 12h; no fixed published quota
entries.notes: Google deliberately publishes no fixed free GPU hours — limits are dynamic (users report ~15-30 T4 h/week). Idle runtimes terminate. As of 2026 the free tier is explicitly 'prioritized for interactive programming'; SSH/remote-desktop banned on free runtimes. Colab Pro ($9.99/mo, 100 compute units) and Pro+ ($49.99/mo, 600 units) add guaranteed/premium GPUs.

entries.name: Hugging Face Spaces — ZeroGPU
entries.offer: Free ZeroGPU inference (shared RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, 48-96GB VRAM): 5 min/day quota on free accounts; free accounts may host up to 2 ZeroGPU Gradio Spaces; Static Spaces free for all
entries.notes: 2026 change (Jul 2026): creating any compute Space (Gradio/Docker, incl. CPU Basic) now requires a paid plan; free personal accounts in good standing (verified email, >30 days old) keep up to 2 ZeroGPU Spaces. ZeroGPU hardware migrated from A100 to RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell with 5 min/day (was ~3.5 min). Gradio SDK only; demos, not training. Community GPU grants available for side-project Spaces.

entries.name: Paperspace (DigitalOcean) — Gradient Free Plan
entries.offer: Free M4000 (8GB) GPU notebook on the free Gradient plan: notebook in private workspaces, 5GB storage, free sessions auto-shutdown after 12h
entries.notes: Free machines are notebooks only (no VMs/SSH servers); capacity is shared and can queue. Paid plans from $8/mo unlock better GPUs; M4000 paid is $0.45/hr, H100 $5.95/hr. No dollar-denominated signup credit — this is a hardware free tier, not a credit.

entries.name: Modal — Starter Plan
entries.offer: $30/month free compute credits on Starter plan (billed per second, T4 through H200/B300 GPUs; ~50 T4-hours or ~7-8 H100-hours); Team plan adds $100/mo
entries.notes: No credit card needed to start; workloads stop when the $30 is exhausted unless billing is added. 2025-2026: the only major recurring monthly free GPU credit left among neoclouds (Beam's equivalent $30/mo was withdrawn by 2026-09).

entries.name: Modal — Academic Credits
entries.offer: Up to $10,000 in free compute credits for graduate students, labs and researchers; startup credit grants (tiered, up to >$1M VC-funded startups) separately
entries.notes: Applied via the Modal pricing/startups pages. Verified Oct 2026; amounts quoted on Modal's own pricing page.

entries.name: RunPod Startup Program
entries.offer: Starter tier: $1,000 free credits for earlier-stage (pre-Series A) AI startups; Growth tier: $25k bonus credits on a $50k committed spend
entries.notes: Venture-backed startups targeted; self-serve Starter credits, no product restrictions. RunPod has no ordinary free tier or signup credit (checked 2026-09); community-cloud GPUs start ~$0.27/GPU-hr paid. A separate academic program (runpod.io/academic-research) gives lab/institution access, billed — not free.

entries.name: Lambda Research Grant
entries.offer: Up to $5,000 in Lambda GPU cloud credits for qualifying academic AI/ML researchers (rolling, competitive), with mentoring
entries.notes: Institutional affiliation + research proposal required; not guaranteed at the max. 2026: no general signup credit, no free trial, and no public 'Lambda student access' offer — this grant is the only free path. Expanded at CVPR 2026 to fund whole research groups. Card required on the Cloud account even when credits cover usage.

entries.name: Lightning AI Studios (Free plan)
entries.offer: 1 free active Studio + up to 30 free credits/month (~80 T4-equivalent GPU-hours on interruptible machines), 50GB storage; no credit card
entries.notes: Phone verification required. Free Studios auto-restart on a 4-hour cycle; 'free hours' differ per GPU tier (T4 ~75h, A100 40GB ~10h, H100 ~5h per 15-30 credits). Verify current credit amount at checkout — details have shifted between 2025 and 2026.

entries.name: Google Cloud Free Trial + Free Tier
entries.offer: $300 credit for 90 days (new users, card required) + Always-Free tier incl. one e2-micro VM/month in 3 US regions (30GB disk, no charge for external IP)
entries.notes: GPUs and TPUs are NOT included in the Free Trial or Free Tier — you cannot add a GPU accelerator to a VM during trial and free VMs are e2-micro only (seed said e2-small; e2-small is paid ~$12/mo). Spend the credit on Vertex AI (Gemini) instead. Trial account closes at day 90 or when credit runs out.

entries.name: Azure Free Account (free VMs)
entries.offer: $200 credit for 30 days + 750 hrs/month of B1s/B2pts v2/B2ats v2 VMs for 12 months + 65+ always-free services
entries.notes: No free GPU VMs: Azure's GPU families (NC/ND/NV) start at zero quota on trial subscriptions with no increases possible — use the credit on Azure OpenAI, not GPU instances. Spend the credit on Azure OpenAI instead.

entries.name: AWS Free Plan (2025 revamp)
entries.offer: New accounts: $100 signup credit + up to $100 more (explore key services), account closes after 6 months or when credits run out; 30+ services free within monthly limits
entries.notes: The old '12 months free tier with 750h p2/p3' is gone: the p3 12h/mo free offer ended in July 2025, and accounts created after that date get the new $200/6-month plan instead. GPU instances are not on the free list — spend credits on SageMaker/Bedrock managed AI.

entries.name: Thunder Compute — Student Credits
entries.offer: $20 free credit for US students, usable on RTX A6000 and L40 GPU instances (~57 A6000-hours or ~25 L40-hours)
entries.notes: Verified 2026-08-21 as the only student GPU credit that actually buys GPU time at a dedicated GPU cloud. Scoped to A6000/L40 only; newer cards excluded. Check the current claim page before relying on it.

entries.name: Camber — GPU Hours via GitHub Student Developer Pack
entries.offer: Free student plan: 5 GPU hours/month + 40 CPU hours + 50GB storage, claimed through the GitHub Student Developer Pack
entries.notes: The pack also bundles $100 Azure credit for students 18+. Camber's offer is recurring (monthly GPU hours), useful for small LLM experiments; verify exact amounts in the current pack listing — DigitalOcean/Paperspace offers that used to be in the pack no longer appear on the page as of Sep 2026.

entries.name: OVHcloud Free Trial
entries.offer: US$200 trial credit for 1 month on Public Cloud; the official docs illustrate using it on GPU notebooks/AI training
entries.notes: One of only three credits (with Modal and Thunder) that has an official GPU path as of Aug 2026. ~35 hours of an AI1-1-GPU notebook per OVH's own example. Card required; EU-based, so useful for EU data residency.

entries.name: Baseten Startup Program
entries.offer: Up to $25,000 credits for Dedicated Inference/Training plus up to $2,500 for Model APIs; new accounts also get unannounced signup credits
entries.notes: Application-based for eligible startups. Baseten is GPU inference/training cloud, so credits buy real GPU time (not just API tokens).

entries.name: Ollama
entries.offer: Free, open-source (Apache-2.0) local LLM runtime — run Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma etc. at $0 on your own CPU/GPU
entries.notes: The 'free tier' is the software: no card, no quota, no API cost — only your hardware. Works on macOS/Linux/Windows; best paired with a used consumer GPU. 2026: default models list keeps expanding; no cloud free tier exists on ollama.com.

entries.name: llama.cpp
entries.offer: Free, MIT-licensed local inference/training in C/C++ — run quantized LLMs with $0 licensing on CPU or GPU (CUDA/ROCm/Vulkan/Metal backends)
entries.notes: Underpins much of the local-LLM ecosystem (GGUF format). No quotas; performance scales with your hardware. 2025-2026: added Vulkan and ROCm support, so AMD/Intel GPUs are first-class, not just NVIDIA.

entries.name: LM Studio
entries.offer: Free desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux) with built-in model store and OpenAI-compatible local server — unlimited local inference at $0
entries.notes: Best no-code route: download a quantized model, serve locally, zero licensing cost. Free tier is the whole product; optional cloud API (LM API) is paid and separate.

entries.name: GPUStack
entries.offer: Free, open-source (MIT) self-hosted AI runtime — one-line install that bundles Ollama-style serving, CUDA/Metal/ROCm support, and a local web UI for free
entries.notes: 2026 note: repositioned itself as a 'local AI runtime' (formerly GPU cluster manager). No cloud free tier; value is running your own GPU fleet at $0 marginal cost.

entries.name: SGLang
entries.offer: Free, Apache-2.0 inference engine (RadixAttention, structured generation, speculative decoding) — run your own high-throughput LLM serving at $0 on any GPU
entries.notes: Actively sponsored for compute (e.g., by Verda/DataCrunch) in 2026; the license remains free. Complementary, not competing, with Ollama/llama.cpp — SGLang targets high-throughput serving and RL training workloads.

entries.name: NVIDIA Inception Program
entries.offer: Free program: cloud-credits from NVIDIA and partners (AWS/Azure/GCP etc., amounts vary by partner) plus data access for early-stage AI startups
entries.notes: 2026 note: most Inception credit value now flows through partner hyperscaler grants (e.g., Google for Startups AI up to $350K, AWS Activate up to $200K, Microsoft for Startups up to $150K) rather than direct NVIDIA credits. Verify current offer amounts in the program portal before claiming.

front_title: Email, SMS, Push & Chat APIs — Free Tiers & Trials

entries.name: Brevo
entries.offer: Free forever: 300 emails/day + up to 100,000 contacts, no card, no time limit
entries.notes: Formerly Sendinblue. Verified 2025-10 against brevo.com. SMS/WhatsApp/push & multi-channel add-ons; 'Sent with Brevo' footer on free; paid Starter from ~$9/mo.

entries.name: Twilio SendGrid
entries.offer: 60-day timed trial: 100 emails/day (Email API + Marketing), then paid from $19.95/mo
entries.notes: MAJOR CHANGE: permanent free-forever plan retired. New signups moved to timed trial in Mar 2025; free plans formally retired May 27 2025 (sending stops after 60 days). Trial is one-time only. Verified 2025-10.

entries.name: Mailgun (Sinch)
entries.offer: Free plan: 100 emails/day (~3,000/mo), 1 custom domain, 2 API keys, no card
entries.notes: The old 'sandbox' is now the Free plan. Verified 2025-10. Paid Basic from $15/mo (10K/mo, no daily cap); Flex pay-as-you-go largely hidden/removed.

entries.name: Resend
entries.offer: Free: 3,000 emails/mo (100/day), 3 verified domains + 1,000 marketing contacts
entries.notes: Developer-first (maker of React Email). Verified 2025-10. Paid Pro from $20/mo (50K/mo); daily quota resets UTC.

entries.name: Amazon SES
entries.offer: 3,000 emails/mo free for the first 12 months of a new AWS account; then $0.10/1K
entries.notes: Lowest per-email cost at scale; new accounts start in sandbox until production access requested; DIY setup (bounces/complaints via SNS). Long-standing AWS free tier.

entries.name: Mailjet
entries.offer: Free: 6,000 emails/mo (capped 200/day), 1,500 contacts
entries.notes: Marketing + transactional, EU-based. Free plan adds Mailjet branding. Numbers confirmed via provider comparison (2025).

entries.name: MailerLite
entries.offer: Free: 1,000 subscribers, up to 12,000 emails/mo
entries.notes: Marketing-focused; card-free; generous free automation & 3 automations. Widely cited as best-value marketing free tier.

entries.name: Mailchimp
entries.offer: Free: 500 contacts, up to 1,000 emails/mo
entries.notes: Cut from 2,000 free subscribers to 500 contacts (2023); free tier capped at 3 audience segments & 1 user. Most user-friendly free plan.

entries.name: Kit (formerly ConvertKit)
entries.offer: Free Creator plan: 10,000 subscribers, 1,000 emails/mo, 1 user
entries.notes: Creator/brand-oriented marketing email; automation included on free. Rebranded ConvertKit→Kit (2023).

entries.name: SendPulse
entries.offer: Free: 15,000 subscribers, 150 emails/day (15,000/mo), 1 user
entries.notes: Bundles email + SMS + push + live chat + WhatsApp on one free plan; one of the largest free contact counts.

entries.name: Loops
entries.offer: Free tier for new accounts: limited subscribers + limited emails/mo
entries.notes: Creator email (ex-ConvertKit team). HEDGED: exact free limits not re-verified this run (web-search budget exhausted) — confirm current caps before citing.

entries.name: Postmark
entries.offer: Time-boxed trial server: historically 100,000 emails/mo free for ~6 months, no card
entries.notes: Transactional-only (refuses bulk marketing) for clean IP reputation; no permanent free tier. HEDGED: verify current trial length/terms.

entries.name: Twilio (SMS/Voice)
entries.offer: Free trial account with trial phone numbers; SMS only to pre-verified numbers
entries.notes: Not a production free tier — trial is for testing; live SMS/voice is pay-per-use. Verify trial number limits.

entries.name: Vonage (Nexmo)
entries.offer: Free trial / testing access for SMS, Voice & Chat (Nexmo)
entries.notes: Vonage acquired Nexmo (messaging) & Nexmo Chat. HEDGED: verify current trial quota — historically free dev/testing sandbox.

entries.name: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
entries.offer: Free forever: unlimited push notifications
entries.notes: Google; no send caps; requires a Firebase project (Android/iOS/Web). De-facto standard mobile push.

entries.name: OneSignal
entries.offer: Free (Starter) plan: up to 10,000 MAU, unlimited app messages
entries.notes: Web/app push + email + SMS on one platform; free tier. HEDGED: re-confirm the 10K MAU free cap (raised from 2.5K in 2024).

entries.name: Airship
entries.offer: Free tier: 100 MAU (Engage)
entries.notes: Multichannel messaging (push/SMS/email). HEDGED: verify current free MAU.

entries.name: Pusher
entries.offer: Free (Realtime) plan: ~5,000 channel pushes/mo, ~100 concurrent connections
entries.notes: Realtime pub/sub & push; company now under Ably. HEDGED: verify current free limits.

entries.name: Ably
entries.offer: Free (developer) tier: up to ~100,000 messages/mo, 2 apps
entries.notes: Realtime messaging over sockets (also owns Pusher). HEDGED: verify current free tier.

entries.name: Stream Chat
entries.offer: Free (developer) tier: up to 50K MAU, 1M messages/mo
entries.notes: Chat API + hosted UI (Chat Messaging, also AI Agents/Feeds). HEDGED: verify current free limits & whether a card is required to go to production.

entries.name: Sendbird
entries.offer: Free (developer) tier: up to 10K MAU, 2 apps, no card
entries.notes: Group/1:1 messaging SDKs (open-source clients). HEDGED: verify current free limits.

entries.name: Tawk.to
entries.offer: Free unlimited live-chat for one domain
entries.notes: Self-hosted web live chat; 100% free, unlimited agents/conversations. Bonus addition (rebranded tawk.to → tawk.me).

entries.name: Datadog Free Plan
entries.notes: 2026: no platform-wide freemium — the free tier covers Infrastructure Monitoring only; the 14-day trial is a distinct thing. Paid starts $15/host (annual).
entries.offer: Free Infrastructure Monitoring up to 5 hosts with 1-day metric retention, unlimited users; separate 14-day full-platform trial (no credit card)

entries.name: New Relic Free Tier
entries.notes: Genuinely permanent (not a trial) — strong for solo devs/small teams; ingest bills $0.40/GB above 100GB. 50+ capabilities included.
entries.offer: Perpetual free tier: 100 GB data ingest/month, 1 full-platform user, unlimited basic users, 500 synthetic checks; no credit card, no expiry

entries.name: Grafana Cloud Free
entries.notes: Most generous managed-observability free tier; community support only. Managed LGTM stack (metrics, Loki logs, Tempo traces).
entries.offer: 10K active metric series + 50 GB logs + 50 GB traces/month, 14-day retention, 100K k6 executions; free forever, no credit card

entries.name: Sentry Developer Plan (Free)
entries.notes: 2025-08-27 change cut included spans 10M→5M and added 5GB logs to all plans; free stays 1 user. Separate 'Sentry for Open Source' program gives OSS maintainers a free plan with Business features.
entries.offer: 5K errors + 5M spans + 50 session replays + 5 GB logs/month, 1 user; free forever

entries.name: AWS CloudWatch Free Tier
entries.notes: Free tier, part of AWS Free Tier. Application Signals/X-Ray free for 3 months or until volume caps. Auto metrics from AWS services are free.
entries.offer: 1M API requests, 10 custom metrics, 5 GB log data, 100 Synthetics canary runs, 3 dashboards, 10 alarms/month; plus 100K X-Ray traces free

entries.name: Honeycomb Free Plan
entries.notes: 2026-07-01 new Pro pricing ($3/M events); the free 20M-event tier is unchanged. Also runs a 'Honeycomb for Builders' startup discount program.
entries.offer: 20M events/month (up to 100M metrics data points), 2 triggers, 60-day retention; free forever

entries.name: Checkly Hobby Plan (Free)
entries.notes: Developer-first 'monitoring as code' (Playwright). Also offers 30% off for startups. Agentic Checks deprecated (stop 2026-12-01).
entries.offer: 10 uptime monitors + 1K browser/Playwright runs + 10K API runs/month, 6 global locations; free forever, no credit card

entries.name: Better Stack Free Plan
entries.notes: Rebranded from Better Uptime + Logtail. Bundles uptime, status page, incident mgmt, logs, error tracking at $0. Paid Responder $29-34/seat/mo; 30% off for startups.
entries.offer: 10 monitors & heartbeats + 1 status page (custom domain), 100K exceptions, 5K session replays, 3 GB logs / 30 GB metrics; free for personal projects

entries.name: UptimeRobot Free Plan
entries.notes: 2025 ToS change: free plan now personal/non-commercial use only — running a paying SaaS technically requires paid. Paid from ~$9/mo (Solo).
entries.offer: 50 monitors, 5-minute checks, 1 basic status page, 3-month log retention; free

entries.name: Statuspage Free Plan
entries.notes: Atlassian-owned (ex-Atlassian/Microsoft). Free tier; paid for white-label/custom domain. Many teams instead use Better Stack/StatusCake free status pages.
entries.offer: 1 free public status page with components and subscriber limits; white-label, custom domain and extra features paid

entries.name: Uptime Kuma (Self-hosted)
entries.notes: The de-facto free option for anyone with a VPS. Fully open source; no free tier from the vendor since you self-host. 20-second check intervals, 90+ notification services.
entries.offer: Open source (MIT) uptime monitor — unlimited monitors, multiple status pages, no vendor caps; free, you host on your own VPS

entries.name: Prometheus (Self-hosted)
entries.notes: Industry-standard OSS time-series DB; the basis of Grafana Cloud / Mimir. Zero licensing cost; you run the storage yourself.
entries.offer: Open source metrics server — free and unlimited; pairs with Grafana for dashboards and Alertmanager

entries.name: SigNoz
entries.notes: Full open source under AGPL; free self-hosted. Managed cloud has a free trial then paid. Popular as a Datadog alternative.
entries.offer: Open-source Observability (OpenTelemetry-native: metrics+traces+logs) self-hosted free; SigNoz Cloud free trial (~50 GB ingest, 30 days)

entries.name: Metabase Community Edition
entries.notes: OSS dashboard/SQL-explorer you can host for free; useful for visualizing telemetry/Postgres. Cloud has a free entry tier.
entries.offer: Open source BI/analytics self-hosted free and unlimited; Metabase Cloud free tier (limited questions/users)

entries.name: Cloudflare (Free Plan)
entries.notes: The main CDN option in this front with a genuinely free tier. Free includes CDN, WAF, basic analytics. Workers/Free usage-based tiers.
entries.offer: Free CDN + global DDoS protection + 100+ global network; Cloudflare Workers free tier (~1M requests/day) — $0 cost

entries.name: PostHog Free Plan
entries.notes: Bundle with observability (errors, logs, traces, RUM/session replay). Free tier generous; 1M events/mo. Startup/early-stage friendly.
entries.offer: Free error tracking, session replay & logs up to 1M events/month; product/feature analytics free tier; no credit card

entries.name: Axiom Free Plan
entries.notes: Logs/metrics/analytics platform; free tier of 5GB ingest/month plus a one-time $10 credit. Usage-based beyond that.
entries.offer: 5 GB ingest/month free + $10 signup credit; log & metric analytics with fast querying

entries.name: Elastic Observability
entries.notes: Trial via Elastic Cloud; the OSS self-hosted stack (Elasticsearch + Logstash + Kibana + Beats) is free under AGPL. Startup credits available on request.
entries.offer: 14-day free trial of Elastic Cloud Observability; open-source self-hosted ELK (Elasticsearch/Logstash/Kibana) free

entries.name: OpenObserve (Self-hosted)
entries.notes: Lightweight OSS all-in-one (logs+metrics+traces+alerts); free self-hosted, single binary. Managed tier has a free start.
entries.offer: Open source log/metric/trace (Rust) platform — self-hosted free; managed cloud has a free starter tier

entries.name: Healthchecks.io Free Plan
entries.notes: Open source (AGPL); self-host free and unlimited. Hosted free tier for personal use. Fits well with CI/cron observability.
entries.offer: Free cron/heartbeat monitoring (OSS) — unlimited checks on your own infrastructure, alerts if a scheduled job stops checking in; hosted has a free tier

front_title: Observability, Monitoring, Uptime & CDN — free offers for students & startups

entries.name: Stripe (Payments & Sandbox)
entries.offer: No setup or monthly fees; free sandbox/test mode and free API docs; pay-per-transaction (2.9% + 30c per successful domestic card txn, 1.5% international).
entries.notes: Base offer is free to develop against; monetization is per-transaction. Pair with the two startup programs below. 2025-2026: Billing pay-as-you-go is 0.7% of billing volume; Managed Payments (merchant-of-record) adds 3.5%.

entries.name: Stripe Startups
entries.offer: Credits to offset Stripe fees for 12 months for venture-backed early-stage startups, plus an exclusive Stripe Invoicing cap starting at 0.4% (up to $10/invoice); no equity taken.
entries.notes: Apply from the Stripe dashboard; requires proof of institutional/venture funding and an account on standard pricing; review ~2-3 business days. Credit amount not publicly published (est. ~$500-$2,000 depending on source). 2026: Invoicing cap explicitly 'starting at 0.4% up to $10 per invoice'.

entries.name: Stripe Atlas
entries.offer: $2,500 in Stripe product credits for the first year + over $50,000 in partner discounts (AWS, Google, Xero, etc.); Delaware C-Corp/LLC formation. Fee $500 one-time, refunded with a $5,000 Stripe Treasury deposit within 90 days; then $100/year.
entries.notes: 2026 current structure: $500 + $100/yr, $2,500 credits, $50K+ partner perks. A retracted 2026-08-28 change record claimed AWS/GitHub/AWS-5k items that never existed on the page — do not rely on third-party 'restructured' claims.

entries.name: Mollie
entries.offer: Free Mollie account with no monthly fees and no lock-in; free test-mode API keys (no transaction fees in test); pay-per-transaction on live; 35+ payment methods.
entries.notes: Test API key isolates you from live data with zero fees; switch to a Live key to process real payments. Mollie also lists a 'For Startups' segment in its portal. Europe-centric (iDEAL, Bancontact, Klarna, etc.).

entries.name: Plaid
entries.offer: Free Sandbox (mock data, unlimited test Items) + free Trial plan for new US/CA teams: up to 10 live Production Items with real bank data, no credit card.
entries.notes: 2026 change: Trial plan (8 products incl. Transactions, Balance, Auth, Investments) is auto-approved for teams created on/after 2026-04-15 and REPLACES Limited Production for new signups; Limited Production (200 free live calls/product) is now legacy/existing-customer only. Beyond 10 Items or for extra products, you upgrade to paid Pay-as-you-go.

entries.name: Tink (Visa)
entries.offer: Free developer Console account + sandbox with a Demo Bank of simulated banks (18 countries, test data) to build/prototype; production access is Enterprise custom pricing.
entries.notes: Tink (Stockholm) is now 'a Visa solution' (Visa acquired it in 2022). 3,400-6,000+ bank connections, 250M+ customers; pay-per-consented-user/call on production. Free sandbox is the developer entry point; no self-serve paid developer plan — production needs a sales contract.

entries.name: Paystack
entries.offer: Free to integrate — zero integration fee, zero maintenance fee, no monthly/minimum fees; free test-mode account with test keys; pay-per-transaction only.
entries.notes: Fees: local cards 1.5% + NGN100 (capped NGN2,000; NGN100 waived under NGN2,500); international 3.9% + NGN100; transfers NGN10-50; virtual accounts 1% capped NGN300. Paystack is 'a Stripe company' (Stripe-backed, YC alumni). Africa-focused (NGN, ZAR).

entries.name: Flutterwave
entries.offer: Free developer account + free sandbox/test environment (mock data, test cards, webhook simulation; test data retained 30 days); live fees are per-transaction.
entries.notes: Sandbox is free for dev/testing before KYC; live processing (US) ~2.9% local cards / 3.8% international, 30+ currencies, 15+ payment options, 20M+ API calls/day capacity. Africa-first PSP (Verve, M-Pesa, USSD).

entries.name: Wise API (Wise Business)
entries.offer: Free API access — no subscription or API fee; free sandbox pre-funded with £1,000,000 of test credit; you pay only per-transfer fees (route-specific fixed + %).
entries.notes: Business account opening fee ~$31 (US) / £45 (UK); API + sandbox free. Partner/platform integrations (client ID/secret, Developer Hub) are sales-led; SMBs use free personal API tokens. 2026: 56+ currencies, batch payments included.

entries.name: Airwallex
entries.offer: Free sandbox (instant, no production account, no real money) + free Explore plan: $0/user/month (US) if you deposit ≥$10K/month or hold ≥$10K; free API in sandbox; multi-currency cards/20+ currencies.
entries.notes: 2026: US 'Explore' is $0/mo under the deposit/balance condition, else paid; 'Grow' adds platform fee by team size. Platform API / Embedded Finance / high-volume are custom (sales). Sandbox rate limit 20 req/s vs 100 req/s production.

entries.name: Paddle
entries.offer: No monthly or setup/migration fees; Pay-as-you-go at 5% + 50c per Checkout transaction (Paddle is merchant of record: payments, tax filing, fraud, support); free developer sandbox.
entries.notes: The only free element is the sandbox for testing — there is no free commercial tier. 2026: standard 5% + 50c; custom pricing for high-volume / sub-$10-value transactions. Good for SaaS/global tax compliance offload.

entries.name: Lemon Squeezy
entries.offer: Free to start: $0/month base, no card, no trial/contract; 5% + 50c per transaction; API, VAT/sales-tax collection & merchant-of-record included; email marketing free up to 500 subscribers.
entries.notes: Lemon Squeezy is 'a Stripe company' (Stripe acquired 2023). Developer/API access included at the $0 base with no separate paid dev tier. Handles global tax (SaaS/digital goods, 95 currencies).

entries.name: Razorpay
entries.offer: 0 setup fee, 0 AMC, 0 integration fee; REST API, official SDKs, webhooks and integration support at no extra cost; pay-per-transaction (2% domestic, up to 3% international).
entries.notes: India-centric; 18% GST on the fee; UPI QR 0.99%, Smart Collect 1% or Rs10; virtual multi-currency accounts 1% on Standard. Free developer account (sandbox) to test; go-live after KYC. 135 currencies / 180+ countries.

entries.name: Moov
entries.offer: No genuine free tier: standard plan is pay-as-you-go with a $500 monthly minimum (Interchange++ + 0.60% + 15c card; ACH same-day 40c; wallet 50c/mo); free test/sandbox environment and free payment links on standard.
entries.notes: Include for completeness of the seed list, but flag it is NOT free-for-all — the $500/month minimum disqualifies it as a free/dev-tier offer. US consumer/enterprise payments & wallets; custom plan for high volume.

entries.name: Adyen
entries.offer: Free test/sandbox environment and free API testing in test mode (no fees, no real money); production pricing is enterprise/contract-based (interchange++ + fee, no API monthly minimum).
entries.notes: Adyen's commercial pricing is not publicly published (sales-led, enterprise/global). The free element for developers is the test account + test mode; the API itself carries no setup/monthly fee. 2026: enterprise onboarding; Tink is listed among Adyen's partners.

entries.name: Chargebee
entries.offer: Growth Starter is $0 and CPQ Lite is free for the first 50 quotes (both require an active paid Billing plan); base Billing is paid (Flow: $0 + 0.80% usage, ~$66K breakeven; or $99 + 0.65% higher tiers).
entries.notes: No standalone free billing tier — the '$0' tiers are gated behind a paid Chargebee Billing subscription. 2026: includes 100M usage events/month on Flow; plugs into 40+ gateways (often on top of Stripe/Paystack).

entries.name: Square (Developer)
entries.offer: Free developer sandbox/test mode and no monthly or annual fees; pay-per-transaction on live (2.9% + 30c per card via Square's payments APIs; ACH per transfer).
entries.notes: Expansion beyond the seed list (added as a well-known payments-API dev tool). Free sandbox; monetization is per-transaction. 2026: Square has an official MCP server. Verify current rates on Square's pricing page before relying on them.

entries.name: AWS Activate
entries.offer: Up to $200,000 in AWS Activate credits (Portfolio tier, VC/accelerator-backed, pre-Series B); self-funded Founders tier $1,000 (up to $5,000); invite-only 'AWS Credits for AI Startups' adds $200K+. Credits now redeemable on Amazon Bedrock third-party models.
entries.notes: 2026 change: cap raised to $200K (was ~$100K) and reorganized into Founders/Portfolio tiers; the old 'AWS Cloud Credit for Startups' seed is folded into this program. AWS is an Activate Provider for YC, a16z, Sequoia, Brex, Carta, Greylock, etc. 7-10 business-day review.

entries.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
entries.offer: Start tier: $2,000 GCP credits (pre-funded, working MVP). Scale tier: up to $200,000 over 2 years (VC-funded, pre-seed to Series A); up to $350,000 for AI-first startups. Includes 12-month free Workspace Business Plus.
entries.notes: 2026: restructured into Start/Scale tiers; AI-first bump to $350K (Yr1 up to $250K). YC companies can stack more via the YC partnership. Third-party model spend is billed separately. Discretionary approval.

entries.name: Microsoft for Startups (formerly Azure for Startups)
entries.offer: Up to $150,000 in Azure 'Startup credits' unlocked by milestones ($200 -> $5K -> $25K -> $50K -> $150K); start immediately with $200. Microsoft for Startups Investor Network referral code unlocks higher tiers faster.
entries.notes: MAJOR 2026 change: rebuilt/renamed from 'Azure for Startups Founders' to milestone-based 'Microsoft for Startups' (May 29, 2026). Lifetime free-credit cap now $350K; must not be past Series C; privately held B2B. Also powers the YC track (up to $150K + AI Foundry + GPUs).

entries.name: IBM Startup with IBM (IBM Cloud)
entries.offer: Flagship 'Startup with IBM' historically up to $120,000 in IBM Cloud credits (Builder $1,000/mo + Premium $10,000/mo, 12 months). As of late 2026 the program appears wound down; current public offer is a $200 new-account credit plus always-free IBM Cloud services.
entries.notes: UNCERTAIN/2026: developer.ibm.com/startups now 301-redirects to the IBM Build community group and no live public $120K page remains; a $120K figure still circulates in IBM forums (Feb 2026) but is not officially posted. Treat as historical until IBM republishes; cross-check before relying on it.

entries.name: Oracle Startup Growth Engine
entries.offer: Up to $60,000 in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) credits (program rules allow $5,000-$100,000 at Oracle's discretion) for VC-backed, high-growth startups with a validated product; launched June 2026 for Brazil/Argentina/Colombia with LatAm expansion planned.
entries.notes: 2026 change: old global 'Oracle for Startups' sign-up retired and replaced by 'Oracle Startup Growth Engine' under the enhanced Oracle PartnerNetwork (eOPN). Excludes existing OCI customers; alternative is up to $60K assessment funding. GTM/customer introductions are 'illustrative,' not guaranteed.

entries.name: Y Combinator
entries.offer: YC companies stack ~$350K+ across partners: AWS up to ~$500K, OpenAI up to $500K (or $2M via SAFE), Anthropic up to $500K, plus GCP/Azure/Gemini credits. A separate YC AI Stack gives students >$20K in cloud + >$5K in GPT/Claude/Grok credits.
entries.notes: 2026 'credit war': OpenAI pitched $2M/uncapped-SAFE to the 2026 cohort, then moved to $500K no-equity + optional $1.5M equity tranche; Anthropic raised its YC offer ~16x to $500K no-equity. YC is an AWS Activate Provider. YC AI Stack (Fall 2025+) is the student angle. YC also offers ~$25K Startup School compute credits.

entries.name: Techstars
entries.offer: $220,000 invested at acceptance ($200K uncapped MFN SAFE + $20K for ~5% equity) plus $1M+ in partner credits: AWS $100K, DigitalOcean $100K, Google Cloud $100K (~24 mo each), plus $250K+ AI/API credits.
entries.notes: 2026: standard deal is $200K uncapped MFN SAFE + 5% for $20K (previously ~$120-180K for 6%). Credits are accessed via Techstars' partner Org IDs; actual per-founder amounts vary by partner/program. Also runs AWS Impact Bootcamps partnership.

entries.name: Cloudflare for Startups
entries.offer: Up to $350,000 in Cloudflare credits across 3 tiers ($10K self-funded / $100K / $350K, by funding amount & partner backing), valid 12 months; includes free CDN, DDoS, WAF (1,000 rules), DNS on all tiers.
entries.notes: 2026: top tier cap is $350K (some third-party guides still say $250K). Requires <=Series B (funded <=12 mo), founded <=10 yrs, live site + LinkedIn/X/GitHub presence, first-time applicants only. AI spend capped at $50K within the credits; 48-hour review.

entries.name: AWS Impact Bootcamps (with Techstars)
entries.offer: $5,000 in AWS credits for underrepresented founders; top participants can win up to $50,000 in unrestricted grant funding plus an extra $15,000 in AWS credits at the AWS Founder Retreat.
entries.notes: Part of AWS's $30M commitment to Black/Women/Latino/LGBTQIA+ founders (2022). Rolling 2-day cities (Tokyo Mar 2026, Berlin Apr 2026). Eligible: self-funded, angel, or up to Series A founders. Distinct from the standard AWS Activate program.

entries.name: DigitalOcean for Startups
entries.offer: Up to $100,000 in DigitalOcean credits over 24 months (Hatch / H100 GPU pool), typically accessed through partner programs such as Techstars.
entries.notes: Figure cross-checked via Techstars capital page ($100K/24 mo). NOT re-verified directly this run (WebSearch budget exhausted); DO's exact public URL/limits may have changed - confirm on digitalocean.com before citing.

entries.name: 500 Global (500 Startups)
entries.offer: Accelerator investment (historically ~$50K-$100K for ~5-7% equity) bundled with ~$50K in partner tech/cloud credits (AWS, GCP, OpenAI, etc.) for demo-day companies.
entries.notes: NOT re-verified this run (WebSearch budget exhausted). 500 Global (ex-500 Startups) runs 500 Global + 500 Capital; specific 2026 credit caps change cohort to cohort - confirm on 500global.com before relying on a figure.

entries.name: a16z / Andreessen Horowitz
entries.offer: No standalone credit program; a16z is an AWS Activate Provider and a Microsoft for Startups Investor Network member, so a16z-backed startups apply for AWS (up to $200K) / Azure (up to $150K) credits using a16z's referral/Org ID.
entries.notes: NOT re-verified this run. The benefit flows through the cloud providers' programs (AWS/GCP/Microsoft), not a direct a16z grant. The 'a16z Speedrun' accelerator also confers portfolio perks. 'verified-company' = needs confirmed a16z affiliation with the fund.

entries.name: Startup Grad (YC + Microsoft)
entries.offer: Historical program that granted YC companies ~$50,000 in Azure credits; effectively superseded in 2026 by the Microsoft for Startups / YC partnership (up to $150K + AI Foundry + GPUs).
entries.notes: Likely defunct under this name as of 2026 - NOT re-verified this run (WebSearch budget exhausted). If a 'Startup Grad' offer still appears it is a legacy label for the Microsoft-for-Startups YC track; verify before citing.

entries.name: AWS Free Tier (new customers)
entries.offer: Up to $200 in credits ($100 at sign-up + up to $100 earned by exploring services) plus free usage of select services; 6-month free plan.
entries.notes: 2026 overhaul: AWS moved to a credit-based free tier (up to $200, 6-month window) replacing the old 12-month free tier. Baseline offer for any new customer, including students/startups, before AWS Activate kicks in.

front: Frontend/edge hosting and app-deployment PaaS that, as of 2026-10-22, has a genuine free tier, free-trial credit, student offer, or startup credit program — verified against official pages. 2025–26 shifts worth knowing: Netlify moved all new accounts to credit-based plans (Sep 4, 2025; Free = 300 credits/mo, thin ~15 GB); Railway restored a permanent $1/mo Free plan (Aug 27, 2025) after running it down in 2024; Render flattened Pro to $25/mo with unlimited seats and cut Hobby bandwidth from 100 GB to 5 GB (Apr 23, 2026); Koyeb (now under Mistral AI, Feb 2026) closed its free Starter plan to new users; Vercel's Hobby is strictly non-commercial. Defunct / no genuine free offer in this front: Glitch (stopped hosting projects Jul 8, 2025 under Fastly), Heroku (no free tier since Nov 2022; from $5/mo "Eco" dyno), Cyclic (cyclic.sh redirects to GitHub; effectively down), Deta (Hugging Face–acquired; deta.space unreachable), and Kinsta / Pantheon / Pika / Cloudron (no perpetual free tier for new users). Entries 13–16 are from secondary 2026 comparisons (Northflank, Val Town, Puter, HF Spaces) — confirm on the vendor page before relying on them.

entries.name: Vercel (Hobby plan)
entries.offer: $0/mo Hobby: 100 GB transfer, 1M edge requests + 1M function invocations/mo, 4 CPU-hrs, 360 GB-hrs memory, 200 projects, unlimited deploys; no card
entries.notes: Non-commercial personal use only — commercial revenue requires Pro ($20/seat). 2025-26: Pro moved to a $20 credit-based model (Sep 2025); Hobby now keeps only the 3 most recent production deployments (Sep 2026). No built-in DB on free tier.

entries.name: Netlify (Free plan)
entries.offer: $0/mo: 300 credits/mo (~15 GB bandwidth at 20 cr/GB, or ~20 production deploys), unlimited deploy previews, functions + edge functions, no card
entries.notes: Sep 4, 2025: new accounts on credit-based plans; Free hard limit = 300 credits/mo and projects PAUSE when exhausted. Legacy Free was 100 GB + 300 build min. Personal $9/mo; Pro $20/mo (unlimited seats). No container option; serverless only.

entries.name: Cloudflare Pages (Free)
entries.offer: $0/mo: unlimited static requests/bandwidth, 500 builds/mo, up to 100 projects, 100 custom domains/project, 20,000 files; no card
entries.notes: Static serving is free and unlimited; dynamic Pages Functions draw on the Workers free quota. 2026: Cloudflare is steering new projects toward Workers rather than Pages.

entries.name: Cloudflare Workers (Free plan)
entries.offer: $0/mo: 100,000 requests/day, 10 ms CPU/request, up to 100 Worker scripts; static assets free & unlimited; paid starts at $5/mo
entries.notes: Daily cap applies account-wide across all Workers. Free also includes KV + container minutes. Paid: 10M requests/mo + 30M CPU-ms, max 5-min CPU/request. Great edge serverless alternative to Vercel/Netlify functions.

entries.name: GitHub Pages
entries.offer: $0/mo: 1 user/org site + unlimited project sites, 1 GB site, 100 GB/mo soft bandwidth, 10 builds/hr; free on public repos (GitHub Free plan)
entries.notes: Static only — no serverless functions or runtime. Private-repo Pages requires a paid GitHub plan. Not permitted for commercial/e-commerce use. Soft limits (rate-limit 429s), not a hard pause, and no billing.

entries.name: Render (Free web services)
entries.offer: $0/mo: free web services (512 MB / 0.1 CPU) with 750 instance-hours/mo, free Postgres (expires 30d), free static sites; no card
entries.notes: Free web services spin down after 15 min idle (~1 min wake); free Postgres expires 30d + 14d grace. 2026: Pro flat $25/mo unlimited seats (was $19/seat), Hobby $0 workspace now includes only 5 GB bandwidth (cut from 100 GB, Apr 23, 2026). Good Heroku-style alternative.

entries.name: Railway (Free plan + trial)
entries.offer: $0/mo permanent Free plan ($1/mo usage credit) + one-time $5 trial credit for 30 days; no card for free tiers
entries.notes: Free plan restored Aug 27, 2025 after being removed in 2024. Usage meters: $20/vCPU-mo, $10/GB-RAM-mo, $0.05/GB egress. Hobby $5/mo, Pro $20/mo per workspace (unlimited seats). Always-on (no forced sleep unless opt-in).

entries.name: Fly.io (Free trial)
entries.offer: Free trial: 2 VM hours or 7 days of access (whichever first), no card; then pay-as-you-go from $1 (smallest always-on app ~$2.19/mo)
entries.notes: Legacy free allowances (3 shared-cpu-1x VMs + $5 credit) were discontinued for new signups on Oct 7, 2024 — only pre-cutoff accounts keep them. Adding a payment card ends the trial and starts billing immediately. Container/microVM PaaS, global multi-region.

entries.name: Koyeb (Startup program)
entries.offer: Startup program: up to $30,000 in credits for early-stage companies; free Starter (1x 512 MB service) grandfathered to existing orgs only
entries.notes: Feb 17, 2026: Koyeb joined Mistral AI; free Starter closed to new users (Feb 2026). New signups default to Pro $29/mo (+$10 compute) with a required card ($29 pre-auth hold). Roadmap now AI/inference-focused.

entries.name: Replit (Starter free tier)
entries.offer: $0/mo Starter: 1,200 dev min/mo (~40/day), 100 AI completions, 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB RAM / 2 GB storage, 1 published app; no card
entries.notes: Browser IDE + deploy. Free tier is public-only, adds a 'Made with Replit' badge, 1 published app. 2026: Core dropped $25 -> $20/mo (Feb 2026); Pro $100/mo; Free Mode (daily Agent cap) added Aug 2026.

entries.name: Replit for Students
entries.offer: 50% off Replit Core (~$10/mo vs $20) with a verified .edu email; Starter free tier remains available
entries.notes: Legacy Teams-for-Education (free for public-school teachers / 80% off classrooms) has been discontinued; the current student benefit is the .edu discount on Core. Verify eligibility on replit.com/education.

entries.name: Deno Deploy (Free plan)
entries.offer: $0/mo: 1M inbound requests/mo, 10 active CPU-hours, 20 GiB egress, 10 GiB revision storage, 10 concurrent apps
entries.notes: Edge serverless built on Deno. Pro $20/mo (5M requests, 50 CPU-hrs); Builder $200/mo. 1-day log/traces retention on free. Good Vercel/Workers alternative for JS/TS edge apps.

entries.name: Northflank (Free Sandbox plan)
entries.offer: Free 'Sandbox' plan: up to 2 compute services + 1 database, always-on (no 15-min sleep); card verified at signup
entries.notes: Koyeb fork marketed as an always-on free PaaS (its main appeal vs Render). Free-tier build minutes/storage not fully published — verify on the official pricing page. Secondary-source verified (2026 comparison).

entries.name: Val Town (Free)
entries.offer: $0/mo: deploy serverless JS/TS 'vals' to a subdomain with one-click forking; user-pays model for built-in AI
entries.notes: Closest cultural successor to Glitch's remix-and-share workflow. AI inside vals is billed to the end user, so the host's bill doesn't scale with your audience. Secondary-source verified (2026).

entries.name: Puter (Free, user-pays)
entries.offer: $0/mo: in-browser IDE + instant live URL + Puter.js (400+ AI models, cloud storage, KV DB, auth) under a user-pays model, no API keys
entries.notes: Open-source (AGPL) 'internet OS'; end-users of your app cover their own AI/cloud usage. Self-hosted build still alpha. No persistent Node server for your app — use static/client code + Serverless Workers. Secondary-source verified (2026).

entries.name: Hugging Face Spaces (Free)
entries.offer: $0/mo: unlimited free static Spaces + free ZeroGPU demos; no card for basic use
entries.notes: 2026: creating new Gradio or Docker Spaces requires a paid plan; static + ZeroGPU stay free. Idle spaces sleep after ~48h. Good for ML/demo app deployment. Secondary-source verified; confirm current policy.

entries.name: Microsoft for Students (Azure for Students)
entries.offer: $100 Azure credit over 12 months (no credit card) + free monthly allowances on 25+ services; free Visual Studio, Office 365, GitHub credits via school verification
entries.notes: 2025 change: credit is now a $100 lump sum (was $25/month); renews annually while enrolled; 'Azure for Students Starter' sub-offer (no card) added; free monthly quotas on 65+ always-free services

entries.name: Microsoft for Startups (Founders Hub)
entries.offer: Up to $150k in Azure credits + partner credits (OpenAI, LinkedIn, GitHub Enterprise); self-serve 'Azure for Startups' gives $1,000 instantly, up to $5,000 post-verification, no application
entries.notes: Founders Hub releases credits in tiers (from $1,000, milestones unlock more); Azure for Startups is instant self-serve (90-day initial / 180-day post-verification credit windows)

entries.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack (GitHub Education)
entries.offer: Free GitHub Pro, 5,000 Actions minutes/mo, 50 GB Codespaces storage + 100+ partner perks (e.g., $200 DigitalOcean, Namecheap domain, JetBrains, Notion offers)
entries.notes: Renewable while enrolled; partner list refreshes periodically; includes GitHub Models LLM access

entries.name: Autodesk Education
entries.offer: Free 1-year professional licenses (AutoCAD, Maya, Fusion 360, 75+ products), renewable while enrolled, for students and educators
entries.notes: Verify via institutional email or school documents; non-commercial use only

entries.name: Unity Personal / Unity Student
entries.offer: Unity Personal plan free (engine, cloud, Asset Store) for individuals/small teams under $200K revenue+funding; free Unity Student plan for students and educators
entries.notes: 2024-25: Personal cap raised from $100K to $200K (revenue AND funding); 2026: Pro priced +5% at $210/mo ($2,310/yr); no runtime fee on Personal; free educational grants for institutions

entries.name: Adobe Creative Cloud for Students
entries.offer: 74% off Creative Cloud Pro for students/teachers (20+ apps incl. Firefly AI); free trial; free Adobe Express and Student Spaces
entries.notes: 2025 change: discount increased from 66% to 74%; region pricing varies (US ~first-year discounted annual; verify local price)

entries.offer: ~50% off Canva Pro first year for verified students (~$49.99/yr vs $99.99) via .edu or national student verification

front: As of 2026-10-22, the perpetual-free leaders for servers are Oracle Cloud (Always Free: up to 2 AMD micro VMs + a trimmed 2 OCPU/12 GB ARM slice, 200 GB block, 10 TB/mo egress) and Google Cloud (always-free e2-micro VM + 30 GB disk, us-* regions). The big clouds otherwise run time-boxed trial credits: since 2025-07-15 AWS no longer gives new accounts a 12-month EC2 free tier — it's now a $100+up-to-$100 credit "Free Plan" that closes at 6 months; Google gives $300/90 days; Azure $200/30 days. Second-tier VPS providers (Vultr, Linode/Akamai, OVHcloud, Hetzner, UpCloud, Kamatera) run $100–$200 trial credits or a $200/2-month no-commitment trial; note that Vultr's and Linode's trial amounts are now promo-code-dependent and no longer fixed in official docs, and DigitalOcean's old $200/60-day trial has been wound down to a ~$5/90-day standing credit. Startup credit programs (AWS Startups, Azure for Startups, Google for Startups, DigitalOcean Startups, Scaleway) add five-figure credits. Seeds with NO genuine free offer were excluded: Contabo, RackNerd, Aeza, Netcup, ExoScale, Kimsufi; IONOS offers only short trials. Several figures here (OVHcloud, Scaleway, UpCloud, IONOS, Kamatera, Azure/Google startup caps) are marked "verify in-console" because their marketing pages are JS-gated and could not be live-fetched this pass.

entries.name: Oracle Cloud Always Free
entries.offer: Perpetual Always Free tier: up to 2 AMD micro VMs (1/8 OCPU/1 GB each) + up to 2 OCPU/12 GB ARM Ampere A1; 200 GB block, ~20 GB object, 10 TB/mo egress, 2 Autonomous DBs (20 GB each); plus a one-time $300 / 30-day trial credit.
entries.notes: The most generous perpetual free tier among the major clouds; a card is required at signup but is not charged while the account stays in 'Always Free' mode. 2025 change: Oracle trimmed the Always-Free ARM allowance (docs moved from 4 OCPU/24 GB to 2 OCPU/12 GB) — confirm current limits in-console. Free ARM capacity is frequently sold out in popular regions; idle instances can be reclaimed.

entries.name: AWS Free Plan (ex-EC2 12-month free tier)
entries.offer: New accounts: $100 credit at signup + up to $100 more by exploring services (up to $200 total) on a Free Plan that auto-closes at 6 months; no perpetual free EC2 for new accounts.
entries.notes: Verify-2026: for accounts created on/after 2025-07-15 the classic 12-month EC2 free tier (750 hrs/mo of t2/t3.micro) was removed and replaced by this credit-based Free/Paid plan model; legacy accounts keep the old 12-month tier. 30+ 'Always Free' services (Lambda, DynamoDB, etc.) remain, but EC2 has no perpetual free allowance. The Free Plan account is deleted ~90 days after it closes.

entries.offer: $1,000 to $100,000+ in AWS credits for qualifying early-stage startups (amount set by program tier / funding stage).
entries.notes: Formerly 'AWS Activate'; apply via the program or a partner VC/incubator. Credits apply broadly (EC2 and beyond). Verify the current tier amounts on the program page.

entries.offer: $200 Azure credit for 30 days for new accounts; plus 12 months of free usage on ~25 services + $100 credit.
entries.notes: The subscription auto-disables when the $200 is exhausted (no surprise bill). No perpetual free VM; the free tier is time-boxed. Some 'free forever' allowances (e.g., Cosmos DB, select VM hours) still apply. Verify the current $200/30d in-console.

entries.name: Azure for Startups
entries.offer: Up to ~$100,000 in Azure credits for qualifying early-stage startups.
entries.notes: Apply through the program or a partner VC/accelerator; credits apply broadly incl. Azure VMs. Amounts vary by stage (historically ~$50k-$150k bands) — verify the current cap.

entries.name: Google Cloud Free Trial
entries.offer: $300 GCP credit for 90 days for new customers; plus per-service Always-Free tier incl. 1 e2-micro VM (us-* regions) + 30 GB disk and 1 TB egress/mo.
entries.notes: The trial billing account closes automatically at 90 days or when the $300 is used (no charge unless you opt into paid). One $300 trial per person/ID. The always-free e2-micro makes GCP one of the only big clouds with a perpetual free VM (alongside Oracle's Always Free).

entries.offer: Up to ~$200,000 in GCP credits for qualifying (mostly US) startups, typically on 12-month terms.
entries.notes: Apply via the program or a partner; credits apply to GCP compute and more. Verify the current amount and country eligibility — the figure has moved over time.
