entries.name: Aiven Free Plan
entries.offer: Always-free plan covering PostgreSQL, MySQL, Kafka, OpenSearch and Valkey — no credit card, no time limit (services power off after long inactivity)
entries.notes: 2025-26 change: Aiven now publishes a no-card, no-time-limit free plan (previously 30-day paid trials). Paid Developer tier from $5/mo (1 CPU/1 GB/8 GB).

entries.name: Aiven Startup Program
entries.offer: Up to $100,000 in Aiven credits over 12 months for eligible startups, plus technical expert access
entries.notes: Listed under Aiven Solutions page 2026-10.

entries.name: Qdrant Cloud Free Tier
entries.offer: Free forever: 1-node cluster, 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB RAM / 4 GB disk (≈1M vectors @ 768 dims), no credit card; free cloud-inference models + up to 5M inference tokens/mo on paid models
entries.notes: Verified on pricing + docs 2026-10. Free clusters suspend after 1 week inactivity, delete after 4 weeks. Competes with Pinecone by starting at $0 with no minimum.

entries.name: Chroma Cloud Starter (ChromaDB)
entries.offer: $0/mo plan: 10 databases (collections), 10 team members, $5 free usage credits, then metered (writes $2.50/GiB, storage $0.33/GiB/mo, queries $0.0075/TiB)
entries.notes: Persistent free plan (credits don't expire); no hard vector caps — everything beyond credits is metered. 2026 change: free tier is credit-based, not a fixed vector allowance.

entries.name: Weaviate Cloud Free Tier
entries.offer: Always free (no card): 1 cluster/user with 100K objects, 1 GB memory, 10 GB disk, 1 collection (≤3 tenants), Weaviate Embeddings 2,000 req/day, Query Agent 1,000 req/mo
entries.notes: 2026 change (announced 2026-06-17): the old 14-day sandbox trial was replaced by this permanent free tier. Free clusters suspend after 7 days inactivity, delete after 30 days total inactivity; AWS-only, cost-optimized HFresh index.

entries.name: Meilisearch Cloud trial
entries.offer: 14-day free trial, no credit card; paid plans from $20/mo (resource-based) or ~$30/mo (usage-based Build: 50K searches + 100K docs); open-source MIT build is free to self-host
entries.notes: 2025 change: the permanent free Cloud plan was retired when resource-based pricing launched (Oct 2025); only the 14-day trial + self-hosted OSS remain free.

entries.name: ClickHouse Cloud trial
entries.offer: $300 free credit over 30 days, no credit card (Basic plan, up to 1 TB storage, 8-12 GiB RAM, 1 AZ, 24h backups); open-source ClickHouse free forever
entries.notes: Trial converts to pay-as-you-go after 30 days or credit exhaustion. Verified 2026-10; no permanent free tier.

entries.name: CockroachDB Cloud trial
entries.offer: 30-day free trial with $400 in credits for new Cloud organizations (Standard edition needs no credit card)
entries.notes: Rebranded to Cockroach Continuum (2026); after trial, clusters pause with a 30-day grace period. The old '20 GB free forever' tier is no longer listed.

entries.name: Upstash (Redis/Postgres/Kafka) free tier
entries.offer: Free serverless Redis: ~500K commands/mo with 256 MB data; Postgres and Kafka metered tiers also free to start
entries.notes: Limits from third-party 2026 check; Upstash homepage confirms 'start free, pay per request' but the pricing page 404'd during fetch — verify exact command caps.

entries.name: Redis Cloud Free tier
entries.offer: Always free: up to 30 MB single DB, shared RAM+SSD deployment, no time limit (best-effort SLA, community support)
entries.notes: 2025 change: Redis (now part of AWS after the 2025 deal) shrank the permanent free tier from the older 128 MB dev tier to 30 MB. Essentials starts ~$5/mo.

front_title: Auth, Security, Product Analytics & Feature Flags

entries.name: Auth0 Free Plan
entries.offer: $0/mo free plan: up to 25,000 MAU, 5 organizations, 1 custom domain, 1 enterprise SSO connection, unlimited social connections, no card required
entries.notes: Free tier raised 7,500 to 25,000 MAU on 2024-09-24 (Okta/"Auth0 plans got an upgrade"); B2C Essentials paid from $35/mo, B2B from $150/mo. Custom domain on Free needs a card on file for verification only. Auth0 for Startups program also exists for early-stage companies; separate startup entry not needed since the free plan is the main hook. Verified at auth0.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Clerk Hobby Plan
entries.offer: Free Hobby plan: 50,000 monthly retained users (MRU) per app, unlimited apps, up to 3 dashboard seats, no card required
entries.notes: Clerk reworked pricing 2026-02-05: free tier jumped 10,000 to 50,000 MRU and billing switched from MAU to MRU ("first day free" — one-time signups never billed); MFA/passkeys/SSO now Pro-only ($25/mo, $20 annual). Verified at clerk.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Firebase Authentication
entries.offer: Spark plan: up to 50,000 MAU free for standard auth methods (email, social, magic link, etc.), 50 MAU free for SAML/OIDC; no card required
entries.notes: Google widened free auth to 50K MAU in 2024 (from 10K). Phone Auth is never free — billed per SMS via Identity Platform. Overflow bills at Google Cloud Identity Platform rates. Verified at firebase.google.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Supabase Auth (Free Plan)
entries.offer: Free: 50,000 MAU auth included plus 500MB Postgres, 1GB storage, 500k edge function invocations; projects pause after 1 week idle, max 2 active
entries.notes: Open-source (Apache-2.0 platform) — can also self-host for free. Pro $25/mo raises included auth to 100,000 MAU (then $0.00325/MAU) and never pauses. Supabase runs regular startup/developer credits and a free "Demos" tier. Verified at supabase.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Keycloak (self-hosted)
entries.offer: Open-source Apache-2.0 identity provider: free to self-host, no MAU/feature limits; enterprise features paid via Red Hat
entries.notes: The standard self-hosted answer for SSO/OIDC/SAML when you outgrow free cloud tiers (Auth0's 25K MAU, etc.). No per-user licensing, but you own the ops. (WebSearch budget exhausted this session; entry based on well-known licensing, not re-verified today.)

entries.name: WorkOS AuthKit
entries.offer: First 1,000,000 MAU free (user management); $2,500/mo per additional 1M MAU above the free cap
entries.notes: The largest free auth tier in the category — but note WorkOS bills enterprise SSO connections separately (~$125/mo per connection per third-party comparisons), so the 1M MAU win is for user management, not SSO. Verified at workos.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Sentry Developer Plan (Free)
entries.offer: Free Developer plan: 1 user, 5,000 errors/mo, 5M spans, 50 session replays, 5GB logs, 10 custom dashboards; Team plan from $26/mo
entries.notes: 2025-08-27 pricing overhaul introduced 5GB logs quotas and cut base spans 10M to 5M; 2026-09 legacy Developer plans migrated to the current free Developer plan (still free, spans-based tracing). 1-user cap is the real limit. Verified at sentry.io/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: LogRocket
entries.offer: 14-day free trial of all features, no credit card; paid starts ~$176/mo (annual) with unlimited error/log/analytics events, sized by monthly sessions
entries.notes: No perpetual free tier; the hook is the card-free 14-day trial. Discounts advertised for students, startups (<$50M raised), non-profits, and open-source. Verified at logrocket.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Mixpanel Free Plan
entries.offer: 1,000,000 events/mo free forever, unlimited seats, 10k session replays/mo, 5 saved reports per user; Experiments/Flags available on Free (1,000 MEU, 10 active flags)
entries.notes: Big 2025 change: in 2025-01 Mixpanel slashed the free tier from 20M to 1M events and moved to freemium; the paid Growth tier (renamed "Startup Plan" in 2025) includes the first 1M events free, so the effective ceiling for non-payers stays at 1M. Over the cap, ingestion stops until month rollover or upgrade. Verified via mixpanel docs/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Amplitude Free Plan
entries.offer: 2M events/mo free forever, 10k monthly session replays, plus AI feedback and agent session allowances; paid Plus starts at $0 for the first 2M events
entries.notes: Replaced the old 50,000-MAU Starter plan with events-based pricing (2M EV free) — a much bigger allowance than the MAU-based era. Verified at amplitude.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: PostHog Free Tier
entries.offer: Monthly free allowances on every product: 1M analytics events, 5,000 session recordings, 1M feature-flag requests, 100k error exceptions, 10GB logs — no card, resets monthly
entries.notes: Note the 5M-figure in older indexes is stale; PostHog's current published free tier is 1M events/mo. Also has a Startup Program: $50,000 in credits/merch for companies under 2 years old and pre-Series B — the largest startup credit in this category. Open-source (MIT) self-hosting also free.

entries.name: Plausible (self-hosted)
entries.offer: Open-source AGPL web analytics: free to self-host the community edition, unlimited sites/visitors; paid Plausible Cloud from ~€9/mo/site, no free cloud tier
entries.notes: The genuinely-free path is self-hosting (GDPR-friendly, single JS snippet). Cloud is paid-only. (Pricing page returned 404 during verification this session; based on known AGPL licensing — confirm cloud prices before publishing.)

entries.name: Simple Analytics Free Plan
entries.offer: Free Hobby plan: 1 user, up to 5 websites, 1 month of history, no credit card; paid self-serve from €20/mo usage-based
entries.notes: New free Hobby tier (added 2025-26) for small personal sites — previously Simple Analytics was paid-only with trials. 14-day self-serve trial unlocks advanced features; enterprise gets a free 30-day POC. Verified at simpleanalytics.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: OpenReplay (Open-Source)
entries.offer: Free open-source self-hosted session replay + analytics + error tracking (no hard event caps); hosted Dedicated starts at $199/mo with a 7-day trial
entries.notes: Unlike Sentry/PostHog the hosted offering has no published free event tier — the free value is self-hosting. Verified at openreplay.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Countly (self-hosted)
entries.offer: Open-source product analytics: free to self-host the OSS core (AGPL/enterprise-edition split); cloud/enterprise plans paid
entries.notes: One of the older OSS analytics platforms; strong self-hosted fit but commercial-grade dashboards/heatmaps sit in paid EE. (Licensing-based entry; not re-verified today because the WebSearch budget was exhausted — confirm current EE boundary before publishing.)

entries.name: LaunchDarkly Developer Plan (free)
entries.offer: Free Developer plan (renamed from "Personal Use"): unlimited feature flags, 1 project, 3 environments, 5 service connections, 1k client-side MAU, 100k experiment MAU, plus 5k errors/replays and 10M logs included
entries.notes: The free plan was rebranded Personal Use -> Developer as LaunchDarkly repositioned around AI observability (AI runs, logs, traces quotas now visible). Paid is now metered pay-as-you-go (Foundation ~$10/service connection + $8.33/1k client MAU annual). Verified at launchdarkly.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Statsig Developer Tier (free)
entries.offer: 2M events/mo free, unlimited flag & config checks, 50,000 session replays/mo, unlimited seats, no card; Pro $150/mo (5M events, then $0.05/1k)
entries.notes: Warehouse-native option lets you run Statsig on your own Snowflake/BigQuery for free (only managed compute costs elsewhere). Exceeding 2M events prompts card/upgrade. Verified at statsig.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Flagsmith Free Plan
entries.offer: Free: 50,000 API requests/mo, unlimited feature flags/environments, 1 team member; Start-Up tier $45/mo ($40 billed yearly, 1M requests, 3 members)
entries.notes: Also open-source (LGPLv3) and free to self-host, which removes the 50k-request cap. Overage on cloud starts at $50/M requests. Verified at flagsmith.com/pricing 2026-10-22.

entries.name: Unleash (open source)
entries.offer: Open-source (Apache-2.0) feature-toggle server: free to self-host with unlimited toggles/environments; Unleash Cloud has a free Personal Use tier, paid tiers start ~$99/mo
entries.notes: The guaranteed-free path is self-hosting; the cloud Personal Use tier existed historically with small request/user caps — the pricing page failed to fetch this session (SSL error), so treat exact cloud free caps as unverified.

front: Dev tools, IDEs, Git & CI/CD front of the free-offers mega-index (offers verified against official pages as of 2026-10-22; web search budget was exhausted partway, so a few lower-confidence entries are flagged in notes).

entries.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
entries.offer: Free verified-student pack: includes free GitHub Pro (3,000 Actions min/mo, 180 Codespaces core-hrs/mo, 2GB Packages, 20GB Codespaces storage), free GitHub Copilot, plus dozens of partner offers (JetBrains, Datadog, Notion, VS Code, GitKraken 6-mo offer, 1Password 2 years, etc.)
entries.notes: Eligibility: 13+, degree/diploma-granting enrollment, school email or proof of enrollment. 2025-2026 churn tracked in the official SDP changelog: DigitalOcean's $200 credit exited after 2026-07-31; Bump.sh removed Dec 2025; 1Password extended to 2 years Oct 2026; Appwrite education plan changed Feb 2026; Clerk, Requestly, LocalStack, Boot.dev added 2025-26.

entries.name: GitHub Copilot
entries.offer: Copilot Free: up to 2,000 completions + AI-credit allowance for all accounts; Copilot Student: unlimited completions + AI credits, free for verified students/teachers; Copilot Pro ($10/mo list) free for verified teachers and popular-OSS maintainers
entries.notes: Plan tiers as of 2026: Free / Student / Pro / Pro+ / Max, with 'GitHub AI Credits' allowances replacing the old 300-premium-request limit; chat/agent usage on free+student is limited to auto model selection.

entries.name: GitHub Actions
entries.offer: Free: 2,000 CI/CD minutes/mo + 500MB artifact storage for private repos; unlimited standard-runner minutes in public repos; self-hosted runners free
entries.notes: 2026-01-01: hosted-runner per-minute prices cut up to 39% (Linux 2-core $0.006/min, macOS $0.062). The $0.002/min self-hosted 'platform charge' announced Dec 2025 was postponed pending re-evaluation; free quotas unchanged.

entries.name: GitHub Codespaces
entries.offer: Free accounts: 120 core-hours/mo + 15GB storage; students: 180 core-hours/mo + 20GB storage; Pro paid tiers start at $0.18/hr compute, $0.07/GB storage
entries.notes: Student allowance is equivalent to GitHub Pro and is part of the Student Developer Pack; Classroom assignment usage bills to the owning org instead of the student.

entries.name: JetBrains Student Pack
entries.offer: Free full IDEs (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion, GoLand, etc.) for students/teachers as long as enrolled, verified via university email, GitHub Student Developer Pack, or official docs; AI tools available via trial/AI Free plan
entries.notes: Annual re-verification required; 40% graduation discount for 2 years after student license expires. Bootcamp/coupon program retired - no new coupons issued after 2026-10-01.

entries.name: Cursor
entries.offer: Free plan ($0/mo) with limited AI usage, limited agent requests and limited chat requests; paid tiers usage-based
entries.notes: Pricing page links a 'Students' education page (details not shown on pricing page as of 2026-10). Legacy 'Hobby'/'Hobby+' plan names are gone - plans restructured; free tier now just caps agent/chat requests.

entries.name: Windsurf
entries.offer: Free plan with monthly AI credits (~$10/mo credit allowance historically; agent 'Cascade' usage limits apply)
entries.notes: LOW CONFIDENCE: windsurf.com now 308-redirects to devin.ai (Cognition's rebrand after the 2025 acquisition) and devin.ai/pricing was unfetchable in-session, so current free-tier limits are unverified. Treat numbers as approximate until checked.

entries.name: Docker
entries.offer: Personal plan free: Docker Desktop (Engine+Kubernetes), Docker Hub, Scout & Debug for 1 user; Team plan $16/user/mo covers small teams up to 100 users
entries.notes: CHANGE: the old 'Docker free for small teams' (under 3 devs / <$10M revenue) was eliminated in the Dec 2024 plan revamp - free tier is now individual-only, so small commercial teams pay for Team.

entries.name: Datadog
entries.offer: Infrastructure monitoring free for up to 5 hosts (1-day metric retention, 100 custom metrics + 500 custom events per host); 40K LLM spans/mo free for Agent Observability; trials for logs/APM etc.
entries.notes: The older 'Dev Tier' (35GB logs, 100K traces, 5 APM hosts) branding has been folded into the current per-product pricing; free 5-host infra tier is the stable entry offer. Paid infra starts at $15/host/mo.

entries.name: Postman
entries.offer: Free plan: 1 user, 100 AI credits/mo, unlimited collection runs and unlimited mock servers (cloud and local), 1,000 API monitoring requests/mo
entries.notes: CHANGE March 1, 2026: plan lineup restructured to Free/Solo/Team/Enterprise; Basic & Professional discontinued; collection runs and mock calls became unlimited on all tiers; Free shrank to a single user (old 3-user free teams gone). Solo $9/mo, Team $19/user/mo.

entries.name: Figma Education
entries.offer: Figma/FigJam 100% free for verified students and educators; higher-ed and bootcamps get free Professional tier, K-12 districts get Enterprise tier; full access to Figma's AI toolkit
entries.notes: Includes classroom add-ons (Google Classroom, SAML SSO), free training/PD sessions and an education template library. No '1 month free Professional' or per-seat cap published on the page.

entries.name: Microsoft for Students
entries.offer: Free 1-year bundle worth $199: Office/Microsoft 365, Visio, Project, MATLAB; plus $99 credit toward the $649 1-year bundle (Windows 11 + Office + Visual Studio + Team); $100 Azure credit for Students + 12 months of Azure for Students always-free services
entries.notes: Core bundle values and $100 Azure credit are long-standing; exact current SKU mix could not be re-verified in-session (localized page returned), so treat as 'confirm before publishing'.

entries.name: CircleCI
entries.offer: Free plan: 30,000 credits/mo (= up to 6,000 build min on small Docker class), 5 active users, 30x concurrency, 2GB storage + 1GB network; free open-source build pool up to 400,000 credits/mo on Linux
entries.notes: Credit-based pricing since the 2025/2026 plan revamp (Free/Performance/Scale). Free-plan credits expire monthly; paid Performance starts at $15/mo with 30,000 credits included.

entries.name: Azure DevOps
entries.offer: Free: 1 Microsoft-hosted job with 1,800 build minutes/mo (plus unlimited self-hosted), first 5 users free, 2GB artifacts free; extra MS-hosted job $40/mo, extra users $6/mo
entries.notes: Read from the official 2026 pricing page; note the free tier has been restructured from the old '2 minutes x 1,800 min' to 1 hosted job - verify against the live page when finalizing. 30-day free trials exist for Test Plans ($52/user/mo tier).

entries.name: GitLab
entries.offer: GitLab.com Free: 400 CI/CD compute minutes/mo per group, 10GiB storage/project, 5 users per private group; GitLab for Startups/Education: free Ultimate license + 50,000 compute minutes/mo
entries.notes: Self-managed GitLab is free/unlimited (bring your own runners & storage), making it the self-host escape hatch alongside Gitea. Open-source projects also get the free Ultimate + 50K minutes offer.

entries.name: Gitea
entries.offer: Open-source (MIT) self-hosted Git platform: unlimited free with your own VPS; try.gitea.io free hosted instances for evaluation
entries.notes: No free tier cap since it's self-hosted - pairs cheaply with any $3-5 VPS (e.g. via cloud startup-credit programs).

entries.name: Replit
entries.offer: Starter plan free: daily Agent credits (Free Mode) up to a monthly cap, monthly cloud credits, 1 free published app (goes offline after 30 days, 'Made with Replit' badge)
entries.notes: Aug 18, 2026: 'Free Mode' launched - no-cost Agent usage (GPT-5.6 Luna) on all plans; Core $20/mo adds $20 credits + up to 30h Free Mode chat. Education program with student/educator discounts at replit.com/education.

entries.name: Linear
entries.offer: Free plan: unlimited members, 2 teams, 250 issues, 10MB uploads; paid Basic $10/user/mo
entries.notes: No separate student/education offer found on the pricing page; the unlimited-collaborator free tier is the de-facto small-team offer.

entries.name: Retool
entries.offer: Free plan: unlimited web & mobile apps, up to 5 users, 500 workflow runs/mo, 5GB storage, 20 agent-hours + 250 AI credits/mo (cloud); self-hosted free with same 5-user cap
entries.notes: Historically '5 free apps'; now unlimited apps with 5 free users. AI/agent allowances are new 2025-26 additions.

entries.name: Tally
entries.offer: Free plan: unlimited form submissions, conditional logic, file uploads, payment collection, integrations (Google Sheets, Notion, Airtable, Zapier, Make, Webhooks) under fair-usage guidelines
entries.notes: Form builder (Typeform alternative); free tier has no stated numeric response cap - throttled only under 'fair usage.' Pro from ~$20/mo adds advanced integrations.

entries.name: Airplane
entries.offer: Free plan: 5 free 'Airplane' internal tools (serverless UI/API functions) with unlimited users
entries.notes: LOW CONFIDENCE: airplane.dev was unfetchable from this environment (DNS failure), so the 5-tool free limit is from pre-session knowledge - re-verify the page before publishing.

front: Self-hosted open-source alternatives that replace paid SaaS — free community/self-hosted editions, vendor free cloud plans, and startup credit programs across the dev stack (workflow automation, internal tools, e-signature, CMS, docs, scheduling, analytics, observability, monitoring, web servers, publishing, surveys). Offers checked 2026-10-22 against official pages.

entries.name: n8n
entries.offer: Self-hosted Community Edition is free with unlimited workflow executions; n8n Cloud free 14-day trial (1,000 executions, no card); Start-up Plan gives 50% off Business for companies under 20 employees
entries.notes: Aug 2025 repricing removed active-workflow limits from all plans; paid cloud from 20€/mo (2,500 executions, 5 concurrent); Community edition is source-available (Sustainable Use License), not OSI open source. Cloud trial expunges data if not upgraded.

entries.name: Windmill
entries.offer: Self-hosted open-source edition free: unlimited executions, up to 3 workspaces, 50 users, 10-user SSO, 10 GiB object storage
entries.notes: Enterprise tier from ~$120/mo (builder seats $20, workers $100/CU pair, per-page examples). Free tier caps email triggers at 100/day.

entries.name: DocuSeal
entries.offer: Fully free self-hosted e-signature platform (AGPL-3.0), replaces paid DocuSign/PandaDoc; no vendor caps
entries.notes: Active project (repo pushed 2026-10, ~18.8k stars, org docusealco). No free hosted tier — you run your own instance.

entries.name: Appsmith
entries.offer: Self-hosted Community Edition free; Cloud Free plan: up to 5 users, 5 workspaces, 10 apps, public apps only; 15-day free trial of Appsmith Business
entries.notes: Paid cloud from $15/user/mo (Business); free tier excludes workflows, reusable packages, audit logs, brand removal. Self-hosted edition is AGPL.

entries.name: ToolJet
entries.offer: Self-hosted Community Edition free; Cloud Free plan: 2 builders, 50 end users, 10 apps, 100 AI credits
entries.notes: Paid cloud from $23/builder/mo; self-hosted Team license from $199/builder; fully offline/air-gapped operation is an Enterprise add-on.

entries.name: Directus
entries.offer: Self-hosted free; Directus Cloud Core $0: 3 seats, 25 collections, 5 flows; Open Innovation Grant gives full commercial access at no cost to orgs under $5M revenue and 50 employees
entries.notes: Cloud hosting add-on $99/mo; paid Team $499/mo; grant removes feature caps for qualifying small orgs.

entries.name: Keystone
entries.offer: Free self-hosted headless CMS framework (MIT) with GraphQL + React admin; no paid cloud tier
entries.notes: Active project (~10k stars, pushed 2026-10). Node.js/TypeScript; bring your own hosting.

entries.name: Payload
entries.offer: Free self-hosted (MIT) full-stack CMS/admin framework on Next.js; no cloud requirement
entries.notes: Active, ~45k stars (repo payloadcms/payload, pushed 2026-10). Payload 3.0 made the framework fully open source.

entries.name: Outline
entries.offer: Free self-hosted knowledge base for personal/internal use; replaces paid Notion/Guru seats
entries.notes: BUSL-1.1 (source-available, not OSI): may not offer it as a hosted service to third parties; each release converts to Apache-2.0 after 4 years. ~41k stars, active (repo outline/outline).

entries.name: AppFlowy
entries.offer: Free self-hosted (AGPL-3.0); cloud Personal plan $0: 1 workspace owner, 100 MB storage, unlimited guest editors, 1 form + 1 chart
entries.notes: Pro $12/member/mo annual; same tiers for self-hosted. ~78k stars; AppFlowy-Cloud repo archived 2026 but hosted service continues.

entries.name: Cal.com
entries.offer: Free self-hosted (AGPLv3); Cloud Free individual plan: unlimited event types, calendars and bookings; Platform Starter (API for builders) free up to 25 bookings/mo, $0.99 overage
entries.notes: Teams $12/user/mo annual, 14-day trial; free plan includes Stripe/PayPal payments and two-way Salesforce/HubSpot sync; rebranded from Calendso in 2022.

entries.name: PostHog
entries.offer: Free self-hosted open source; Cloud free tier: 1M events/mo, 5K session recordings, 100K error exceptions, 1,500 survey responses, 10K workflow messages (no card, renews monthly); PostHog for Startups: $50,000 credits for 12 months (<2 yrs old, <$5M raised) plus $12K partner perks
entries.category: Product analytics / observability (replaces Mixpanel/Amplitude + GA4 + Sentry)
entries.notes: 2026 change (Sep 14): startup credits no longer apply to AI tools (PostHog AI, Desktop, Slack app, Replay Vision, Inbox). YC teams get $50k/yr while <$25M raised. Self-hosted core is MIT licensed.

entries.name: SigNoz
entries.offer: Self-hosted Community edition free (all features, no caps); SigNoz Cloud: 30-day free trial, no credit card; Teams plan from $49/mo including $49 of usage
entries.notes: May 2025 change: cloud minimum cut from $199 to $49/mo; usage $0.30/GB logs+traces, $0.10/mn metric samples. Third parties report a startup deal (~$19/mo first 12 months, <3 yrs old, <30 employees, <$6M raised) — verify on vendor site.

entries.name: Uptime Kuma
entries.offer: Completely free self-hosted monitoring (MIT), unlimited monitors, no tier limits
entries.notes: ~92.7k stars, pushed 2026-10-22. Official domain is uptimekuma.io (uptimekuma.com did not resolve from this environment); any hosted 'Kuma Cloud' status unverified here.

entries.name: Caddy
entries.offer: Free, open-source web server (Apache-2.0) with automatic HTTPS built in; no paid plans at all
entries.category: Web server / TLS termination (replaces Nginx + cert tooling)
entries.notes: Community project; no commercial offering or cloud service to attach a free tier to — the product itself is the free offer.

entries.name: Nginx
entries.offer: Nginx OSS free (2-clause BSD); F5 also offers a free annual 'Nginx Plus for Development' license (confirm current availability at F5)
entries.category: Web server / load balancer (replaces commercial edge stacks)
entries.notes: Nginx Plus/NGINX One is commercial (F5); nginx.com product pages now redirect to f5.com/products/nginx. Developer license terms not restated on that page in 2026 — verify before indexing.

entries.name: Ghost
entries.offer: Self-hosted Community Edition free (MIT), no member caps or revenue share; Ghost(Pro) hosted plans start at $18/mo with free trials
entries.notes: Ghost(Pro): Starter $18, Publisher $29 (both 1,000 members), Business $199 (10,000 members); no payment fees, cancel anytime.

entries.name: BookStack
entries.offer: Completely free self-hosted documentation/wiki (MIT), no cloud service and no limits
entries.notes: PHP/Laravel; books-chapters-pages structure; the go-to lightweight self-hosted Confluence alternative.

entries.name: Documenso
entries.offer: Free self-hosted e-signature (AGPL); Cloud Free: 5 documents/month, up to 10 recipients per document, free forever
entries.notes: Paid: Individual $25/mo, Teams $40/user/mo, Platform $250/mo; self-hosted enterprise licensing available for unlimited signatures.

entries.name: Formbricks
entries.offer: Free self-hosted open-source surveys/feedback; Cloud Hobby free: 1 workspace, 250 responses/month, full API (incl. MCP) access
entries.notes: Cloud hosted in Frankfurt; Pro $74/mo (2,000 responses); self-hosted edition has no response limits.

entries.name: Kitem
entries.offer: UNVERIFIED — could not confirm a currently active offer as of 2026-10-22
